title: Greedy Algorithms for Fair Division of Mixed Manna
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic game theory and social choice, specifically the mathematical properties of fair division for indivisible items. While 'fairness' is a central concept, it is treated as a technical requirement (such as envy-freeness) within resource allocation problems rather than a study of moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religion in the context of language models or NLP systems.
